speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Occipital Neuralgia (Right Greater Occipital Nerve entrapment). The specific finding of tenderness in the right postauricular/tonsillar area upon tapping, combined with shooting pain and difficulty wearing earrings after tympanoplasty, is highly suggestive of entrapment or irritation of the greater occipital nerve, likely exacerbated by surgical positioning or scarring near the mastoid.
